screen: Registered T5 building-to-road distance county-held-out residual screen; descriptive-only unless fixed gates pass

method.feature: Use the frozen T5 emission only: fraction of provided Overture building centroids assigned within the ACS tract and more than 150 m from any provided Overture road.
method.feature_formula: 1 - buildings with nearest provided-road distance <=150m / assigned provided buildings; denominator-zero tracts are undefined. 150m and centroid-within assignment remain fixed.
method.outcome: Pinned frozen S1 cross-fitted estimator-disagreement residual; no target or reference layer read.
method.validation: Within each official region, hold out each supported five-digit county FIPS in turn; fit on all other supported counties in that region.
method.correction: OLS intercept plus one T5 term; feature mean and population SD computed only on training counties; held-out features use training statistics; zero SD scale=1.
method.baseline: Zero correction of frozen S1 residual on identical T5-defined support.
method.metric: Pooled and regional county-held-out ΔR²=(baseline SSE - OOF model SSE)/baseline SSE; 2,000 paired county-block bootstrap replicates within each region.
method.rurality_sensitivity: Descriptive OOF residual fit by provided pct_urban (<0.5 rural, >=0.5 urban); fixed cut, no outcome-based tuning.
method.area_sensitivity: Descriptive OOF residual fit across four pooled equal-frequency quartiles of provided ACS tract polygon area in EPSG:5070 (km²); cut points from feature support only, no outcome-based tuning.
method.interpretation_limit: Residual association is not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county baseline/model SSE blocks; county sampled with replacement within each official region

tract_area_quartiles.cut_method: pooled paired-support quantiles; linear interpolation; fixed descriptive bins, no tuning

descriptive_rurality_and_area_inputs.area_source: provided ACS tract polygons projected to EPSG:5070; area in km²; used only for descriptive quartiles

interpretation: The T5 feature failed one or more fixed pooled/CI/urban-rural gates; keep descriptive-only and do not integrate.
